tools.name: Agents Repo Map
tools.make_command: make repo-map [TARGET_PATH=. OUTPUT_DIR=.agents/arc/map RUNNER=/path/to/run-repo-map.sh IMAGE=docker-analisys-tools:latest DRY=1]
tools.description: Runs the deep repository analysis pipeline and refreshes the full current-state codemap under .agents/arc/map using the external docker-analisys-tools runner.
when_to_use: When .agents/arc/map needs a fresh repository-wide codemap
After major architectural refactors, file moves, or domain boundary changes
Before deep architecture analysis that should rely on generated artifacts instead of broad manual reading
When onboarding a repo that needs current-state maps beyond the lightweight structure map
options: path: Optional repository root to analyze (default: current directory)
--image: Docker image tag for the analysis toolbox
--dry-run: Print the resolved runner command without executing it
checks: Resolves repo root and map output path deterministically
Finds the external run-repo-map.sh runner via CLI flag, env var, config, or default hint
Ensures the output root exists before execution
Fails if required root codemap docs are missing after the run
tools.output: Generated or refreshed codemap markdown files and raw evidence under .agents/arc/map and .agents/arc/map/extra
